_meta.title: SMTP (with login)
_meta.setup: Ideally a mailbox just for tentaclAI. STARTTLS on 587 or SSL on 465 (security). Put user and password into .env.

examples: svc mail NAME send --to someone@example.com --subject "Report" --body-file report.txt
notes: confirm: every mail waits for approval. write sends without asking and needs smtp.recipients (addresses or @domain).
